text: The student can enroll at any time of the year and the participants can choose to enter the class directly or take one-on-one study. 1. Language Skill Courses: Synthesis course, Oral Chinese, Listening, Listening and Speaking, Newspaper Reading, Reading Comprehension, Video Course. 2. Literature Courses: Chinese Idioms, Calligraphy, Painting, Chinese Movie Study, Performance, Taiji Quan, Pronunciation, Chinese Folk Song, English, Scientific Chinese, HSK
